ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Embedded Platform team owns the on-device software that ensures Base’s fleet of Linux-class hardware runs workloads reliably and securely, APIs for interacting with devices individually and at scale, and the telemetry stack that provides visibility at both the device and fleet level. As an embedded software engineer on the team, you’ll own complex, mission-critical systems on our fleet of devices end to end: bootloaders, secure boot, kernel drivers, networking, telemetry storage and offload, application data streams, and more.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design, build, and ship reliable, performant, and secure SDKs that control and monitor Base’s batteries across our fleet of Linux-class hardware.

 - Own platform software end to end across the full stack: bootloaders and secure boot, networking, kernel and device drivers, and build systems.

 - Build scalable tracing infrastructure that collects core dumps, logs, and diagnostics across our compute platforms and moves them reliably to cloud-based log ingest and indexing backends.

 - Ship the device-side features of Base’s in-house fleet management platform: device telemetry, remote configuration, and safe OS and firmware rollouts.

 - Investigate hard problems down to the root cause, from first principles, and borrow ideas from adjacent fields like cloud and distributed systems when they offer a better answer.

 - Write and review system design docs, share ideas openly, and help raise the bar for how the embedded platform team designs and builds software.

 - Support platform software across the whole product lifecycle, from prototype through production, scale, field support, and end of life.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Hands-on embedded, Linux, or OS-level software experience with a hardware product across its full lifecycle (prototype, production, scale, support, end of life), and the ability to talk candidly about the tradeoffs and what you’d do differently now.

 - Strong systems programming skills in Go, C++/C, or Rust: data structures, memory and resource management, concurrency, and threading.

 - Breadth across platform software: bootloaders and secure boot, Embedded Linux, kernel and device drivers, networking, or build systems.

 - The instinct to dig deep into problems, find root causes from first principles, and look for existing solutions before building new ones.

 - Clear communication about design choices and tradeoffs, and a collaborative, low-ego approach to working with your team.

 - Curiosity and a growth mindset. You keep up with new approaches, libraries, and SDKs in the embedded platform and systems communities.

 - A strong work ethic and a bias toward action and solutions.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Embedded Platform team owns the on-device software that ensures Base’s fleet of Linux-class hardware runs workloads reliably and securely, APIs for interacting with devices individually and at scale, and the telemetry stack that provides visibility at both the device and fleet level. As a software engineer on the team, you’ll own complex, mission-critical systems end to end: bootloaders, secure boot, kernel drivers, and networking on the device; telemetry ingest, data warehousing, and query interfaces in the cloud; and the fleet management and orchestration systems that tie them together. As the fleet grows and our hardware portfolio expands in both breadth and capability, the job gets harder: more devices, more workloads, and less room for error. If you want to own mission-critical systems software end to end, from the bootloader to the cloud, and see it running across a fast-growing fleet, this is the team.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.
